judge.rationale: The candidate satisfies every acceptance criterion from the issue: it removes the `instanceof Error` gate on `onError`, wraps non-`Error` rejections in `new Error(..., {cause: error})`, rethrows the original value unchanged, and updates the spec, line-number anchors, and `CHANGELOG.md`. The candidate also leaves behind an untracked `.lore/dod.md` scratch artifact and a separate `onErrorNonError.acceptance.test.ts` file that duplicates coverage already added to `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts`.
